m: मच् (cf. √ मञ्च्) cl. 1. Ā. मचते (pf. मेचे &c.), to cheat, be wicked or arrogant; to pound, grind, Dhātup. vi, 12.
a: मच् — {c1c} A. (मचते) 1 To be wicked. --2 To cheat, deceive. --3 To be vain or proud. --4 To pound, ground.

m: मच्छाक्षाङ्क mfn. marked with a fish-eye (said of a bad pearl), ib.

s: puM, (mAdyati salileneti । mad + kvip । taTA san Sete iti । SI + qaH .) matsyaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: puMstrI॰ mAdyati mada--kvip taTA san Sete SI--qa । matsye Sabdara॰ । striyAM jAtitvAt NIz ।
m: मच्छ m. (Prākṛ. for मत्स्य) a fish, L.
मच्—छरीर (मद् + शर्˚) n. my body, ib.

s: i Na ucCrAyaDftyarccABAHsu । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-Atma॰-DftO arccAyAYca saka॰-dIptO uccIBAve ca aka॰-sew .) i maYcyate । Na maYcate । ucCrAya uccIBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

Na ca kalkane । damBe । SAWye । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-Atma॰-damBe SAWye ca । aka॰-kalkane-saka॰-sew .) kalkanamiti kalkaM karotIti YO rUpaM cUrRIkaraRamityarTaH । Na macate taRqulaM SilA cakArAt maci Na । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: damBe SAWye ca aka॰ BvA॰ A॰ sew । macate amacizwa mece ।
uccatAkaraRe DAraRe pUjAyAM ca saka॰ dIptO aka॰ BvA॰ Atma॰ sew idit । maYcate amaYcizwa । maYcyate ।

m: मचक-चातनी prob. w.r. for मेचक-च्˚, q.v.
मचक्रुक m. N. of a Yakṣa and of a sacred spot guarded by him near the entrance to Kuru-kṣetra, MBh. (cf. मङ्कणक).

s: strI, (maM SaBuM carccatIveti । carcc + Rvul । wAp । ata itvam । vastutastu rUQo'yaM SabdaH .) praSastam । ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 27 ॥ (yaTA, praSasto brAhmaRo brAhmaRamacarccikA । “praSaMsAvacanESca । 2 । 1 । 66 । iti samAsaH .)

v: strI carca--DAtvarTanirdeSe Rvul masya SamBoriva carcikA DyAnam । praSaste amaraH avyutpanno'yamityeke “matallikAdayo niyataliNgA na tu viSizyaniGnAH” si॰ kO॰ “praSaMsAvacanESca” pA॰ asya viSezaRatve'pi paranipAtaH gomacarcikA gotamallikA ityAdi ।
m: मचर्चिका f. (ifc.) excellence, anything excellent or good of its kind (cf. गो-म्˚) g. मतल्लिकादि (Gaṇar.)
a: मचर्चिका — A word used at the end of a noun to denote ‘excellence’ or ‘the best of its kind’; as गोमचर्चिका ‘an excellent cow or bull’; cf. उद्ध.

k.v: मतल्लिका मचर्चिका प्रकाण्डमुद्धतल्लजौ। प्रशस्तवाचकान्यमून्ययः  शुभावहो विधिः॥

m: मच्-चित्त &c. See under 1. मद्, p. 777, col. 2.
मच्—चित्त mfn. having the mind (fixed) on me, thinking of me, Bhag.
